global_style: A minimalist, artistic presentation template utilizing a muted Morandi palette, organic brushstroke framing, and clean geometric content structures.

identity_anchors: Abstract, painted organic brushstrokes functioning as asymmetric edge framing
Alternating deep slate and soft blush color blocking
Prominent circular badges for numbers and icons overlapping rectangular containers
Elegant serif typography for major headings

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
